name: react-nextjs-daisyui-workspace
description: Workspace root for the react-nextjs-daisyui example. It declares no dependencies of its own. It exists because Dependabot cannot find a pnpm-lock.yaml whose workspace root has no package.json (it bumped web/package.json nine times and never this lockfile, #1050), so .github/dependabot.yml points at this directory instead of at web/. The packageManager pin must equal the repo root's (just verify-pnpm-pins). Members are listed in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
